subject: Scantwo memory consumption increases with time

messages.author: 74bb2243bb8c3b1b
messages.subject: Scantwo memory consumption increases with time
parts:
Hi 

I'm running sacntwo for 150 sample with n.perm=500 and my jobs ended with error out of memory. While looking closely we found from the beginning of permutations it don't grab that much memory but when we went on higher permutation it is giving this kind of error. I can run n.perm=250 but not n.perm=500. If I understand the algorithm correctly the memory usage in each step should be the same .. isn't it?

Can anyone has a suggestion for that?

Best,
Taslima

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Scantwo memory consumption increases with time
parts:
scantwo is a bit of a mess.

I'd suggest splitting the n.perm=500 into two groups of 250, run in series; combine the results afterwards with rbind().

If you're using Haley-Knott regression, try scantwopermhk(), which uses a different strategy.

karl
